purpose: Apply targeted, auditable corrections after Codex methods audit of the DeepSeek API v0.3 run. These overrides correct internal inconsistencies in manuscript-facing categories while preserving raw API outputs separately.
global_rules: Retraction Watch Reason terms remain non-exclusive curated metadata, not fault or liability determinations.
Post-publication process/oversight signals include investigation-source and procedural-communication reasons, but do not imply that the investigating actor caused the problem.
Broad misconduct labels should not be expanded into research-content, attribution, or editorial-governance categories unless the official definition specifies the mechanism.
Status-only notice/update/removal reasons can retain an audit category but should have main_figure_recommended=false unless they are used in a separate transparency/metadata figure.

Investigation by Journal/Publisher.caution: Investigation source/process signal only; not publisher fault. Included as post-publication oversight/process signal.

Investigation by Company/Institution.caution: Institution/company investigation source signal only; not institutional fault. Included as post-publication oversight/process signal.

Investigation by ORI.caution: ORI investigation source signal only; not causal attribution. Included as official post-publication oversight/process signal.

Investigation by Third Party.caution: Third-party investigation source signal only; not third-party fault. Included as post-publication oversight/process signal.

Miscommunication with/by Author.caution: Communication-process signal; does not imply misconduct or fault by the author.

Miscommunication with/by Company/Institu.caution: Communication-process signal; does not imply institutional fault.

Miscommunication with/by Journal/Publish.caution: Communication-process signal; does not imply journal/publisher fault.

Miscommunication with/by Third Party.caution: Communication-process signal; does not imply third-party fault.

Concerns/Issues about Third Party Involv.caution: Third-party involvement is too broad for a main mechanism category; retained only as a broad process/oversight audit signal.

Error by Third Party.caution: Third-party error is non-specific; retained only as a broad process/oversight audit signal.

Misconduct by Author.caution: Broad misconduct statement; do not infer specific content, attribution, or editorial mechanism unless separately coded by another reason.

Misconduct by Company/Institution.caution: Broad misconduct statement; do not infer specific content, attribution, or editorial mechanism unless separately coded by another reason.

Misconduct by Third Party.caution: Broad misconduct statement; do not infer specific content, attribution, or editorial mechanism unless separately coded by another reason.

Misconduct - Official Investigation(s) a.caution: Official misconduct investigation/finding signal; mechanism-specific categories require separate reasons such as data, image, authorship, or peer review.

Ethical Violations by Author.caution: Generic ethical-violation label used when no more specific reason is available; do not infer content, attribution, or editorial mechanism from this label alone.
